quotes.text: “ Glory to Him who reigns the King of Heaven 1 -Glory to Him to whom all power is given!

31. Nevertheless thine enemy is in thine hands, and if thou reward
    him according to his works, thou art justified; if he have sought
    thy life, and thy life is endangered by him, thine enemy is in
    thine hands and thou art justified.
